description: The plot shows how accuracy (ACC) varies with co-occurrence number for six methods (Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and is on a logarithmic scale, spanning from near 0 up to slightly beyond 10^3 (with major tick labels at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3); the plotted x positions appear at approximately 5, 30, 300, and 3000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 85 with labeled ticks every 5 units (60, 65, 70, 75, 80). The Base series is a black solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 64% at ~5 to about 71% at ~3000 (with intermediate points near ~66.5% at ~30 and ~69% at ~300). FT is a blue solid line with downward-triangle markers, rising from about 65% at ~5 to about 73% at ~3000 (around ~69% at ~30 and ~71.5% at ~300). IKE is a red solid line with upward-triangle markers, increasing from about 67.5% at ~5 to about 75% at ~3000 (near ~72% at ~30 and ~74.5% at ~300). MEND is a brown solid line with diamond markers, moving upward from about 70.5% at ~5 to about 80% at ~3000 (around ~75.5% at ~30 and ~78.5% at ~300). MEMIT is a purple solid line with pentagon markers, increasing from about 69.5% at ~5 to about 77.5% at ~3000 (near ~74% at ~30 and ~77% at ~300). ROME is a green solid line with square markers, rising from about 74.5% at ~5 to about 84% at ~3000 (around ~79.5% at ~30 and ~82.5% at ~300). A legend in the upper-left maps colors and marker shapes to method names.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy percentage (ACC) across different methods. The x-axis is labeled 'Co-occurrence Number' and uses an exponential scale, with values ranging from 1 to 1000 and tick labels at approximately 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled 'ACC (%)' and uses a linear scale, with values ranging from 60 to 80 percent and tick labels at intervals of 5 percent. The plot displays six lines: a black line with circular markers representing 'Base', starting at approximately 64% ACC at 5 and increasing to about 72% slightly beyond 10^3; a blue line with downward-pointing triangular markers for 'FT', starting at around 65% and rising to roughly 74% slightly beyond 10^3; a red line with upward-pointing triangular markers for 'IKE', beginning at about 67% and increasing to nearly 76% slightly beyond 10^3; a brown line with diamond markers for 'MEND', starting around 68% at 5 and ending near 79% slightly beyond 10^3; a purple line with pentagon markers for 'MEMIT', beginning at approximately 70% at 5 and ending around 80% slightly beyond 10^3; and a green line with square markers for 'ROME', starting at about 75% at 5 and rising steadily to approximately 85% slightly beyond 10^3. Each line follows a generally upward trend as the co-occurrence number increases, with 'MEMIT' showing the steepest rate of improvement. A legend is given in the top left, describing the line and color.
